about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/paladin/retribution, game 1.60.1.70959, site built 2026-11-18 from commit ab0f00e). Its Unsealed Wrath build (talents 050250002-501-05233011201301351, rotation, buffs, consumables) on its own Default gear set (ui/specs/paladin/retribution/gear_sets/default.gear.siml, imported as SIML), 25,000 iterations, reference stat Attack Power. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Its 1% Spell Hit Holy (3.43) and Main Hand Weapon Skill (18.05) aren't item stats and aren't kept. Used in place of the preset's UnsealedWrathEpWeights, whose Haste (22.87 per rating, 228.7 per 1%) and Hit (68.3 per 1%) were far from what the tool measures for that same build. Run in the app's browser on 18 Nov 2026 (US Central).
